blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Filipino Alex Eala leads Team Philippines’ campaign in the tennis competitions of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Also on the Philippine tennis team in Japan are Madis Tenielle, Stefi Aludo, Shaira Rivera, and Francis Alcantara. Eala, ranked 18th in the WTA, is the top seed in the women’s singles tournament. She is also entered in the women’s doubles event with Rivera.
